title: SETA Seed2Synth
input: Upstream seed metadata and source assets: start with a small published notebook or Q&A subset.
native_output: Harbor task directories plus synthesis status and author reports.

execution.runtime: VM sandbox with Docker and Apptainer

conversion.approach: Keep native Harbor artifacts. Apply only documented schema/runtime compatibility changes in a separate export copy.

deviations: Independent frozen Unix.SE inputs replace the gated published seed split.
SDK budget/turn caps; optional offline and repaired-reference variants retained separately.
known_limitations: Keep the upstream author-report verdict; independently measure actual oracle and baseline results. Do not replace its authoring workflow with Tasksmith.

why_this_order: Native Harbor output and a standalone synthesis mode; first prove one complete upstream run.
